## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the proposed capability.

## Motivation & Use Case

Why is this feature needed? How does it serve Arle's developmental autonomy, agency, or companionship with Proof?

## Architectural Boundary

- [ ] Contracts / Schema (`@arletex/contracts`)
- [ ] Cognitive Control Bus / APE Engine (`@arletex/core`)

- [ ] Inference / Specialist Pipeline (`@arletex/inference`)

How will this feature be empirically verified? (e.g. Vitest scenario test, target hardware validation).

## Additional Context

Add any diagrams, research citations, or alternative approaches considered.
